_meta.title: Day 23 — Conversation repair
_meta.commit_message: fix: structural ENUMERATE gate + premise-confirmation path
_meta.purpose: Every session through Day 22 measured the bot answering questions about itself. This one measures whether it can hold an ordinary conversation with a developer: introduce itself without reciting hardware, scope its own capabilities, take a debugging request, name a real gap, give a compact status, and carry context across two turns. The recurring failure the whole day targets is the hardware dump — the model reaching for LIVE HARDWARE READINGS when the question was social or task-shaped.
design_notes: conv-follow is the only multi-turn row: turn 2 is posted only after turn 1's answer has landed, so the second prompt is a genuine follow-up rather than a batch.
Deployment role (web dev / GPIO / ROS2) is the frame the operator actually wants; Minecraft is a testing sandbox and leading with it is the failure, not the mention itself.

Word ceilings are the prompt builder's, not the grader's: all six prompts are non-enumerating, so conv-intro/conv-what-can-you-do/conv-whats-next/conv-status take the SHORT 40-word branch at <=12 words and conv-flask/conv-follow take the 120-word default.

pass_criteria: names AKSUMAEL
states T7/Victus hardware
mentions deployment role (web dev / GPIO / ROS2)
NO Minecraft in the first 2 sentences
NO capture card mention unless asked

objectives.prompt: What can you actually help me with right now?
pass_criteria: lists capabilities (web dev, GPIO, ROS2, path planning, sensor fusion)
does NOT recite the hardware block
does NOT mention Minecraft

objectives.prompt: I have a Flask app returning 500 on one endpoint. What do you need from me to help?
pass_criteria: asks for the traceback or error log
offers to help debug
does NOT dump hardware state

objectives.prompt: What do you think you need to learn next?
pass_criteria: identifies a genuine gap (edge fleet coordination, or a real skill it lacks)
does NOT claim all skills are ready
does NOT fabricate training history

objectives.prompt: Give me a quick status — what's running, what's not?
pass_criteria: accurate summary from live blocks (tick, mode, services)
compact answer under 80 words
does NOT invent states

objectives.prompt: I'm trying to use FastAPI with a background task that's silently failing.
objectives.prompt_turn_2: The task runs but the database write never happens.
pass_criteria: maintains context across the two turns
asks useful follow-up questions
does NOT reset to a hardware dump on the second message
